Chapter 7.2, Dynamic Temperature Determination, First Edition, June 1985

This section describes the methods and practices used to obtain flowing temperature measurements using portable electronic thermometers in custody transfer of liquid hydrocarbons. This section also covers blanketed tanks and tanks that have been made inert and are under pressures of less than 3 psig (21 kilopascals). It does not cover hydrocarbons under pressures in excess of 3 psig or cryogenic temperature measurement. 7 pages.

Price each, $5.00
